highlights.description: Module renamed from `prism-control` to `prism-build` to match the GitHub repository and align with the prism-* module family
All store entity structs now carry JSON tags for IR export, enabling visionstudio to import them as its execution domain types

breaking.description: Import paths changed from `github.com/ProductBuildersHQ/prism-control/...` to `github.com/ProductBuildersHQ/prism-build/...`; root SDK package renamed `prismcontrol` → `prismbuild`

added.description: JSON tags (snake_case) on all store entity structs: Program, Initiative, Phase, RoadmapItem, Assignment, DeliveryEvidence, Repository, dependency edges, SpecWorkflow, JudgeRubric, JudgeResult, CapabilityModel, MaturityAssessment

fixed.description: Resolved golangci-lint gosec/dupl warnings: WriteFile permissions tightened to 0o600, nolint directives for false-positive G101 and safe G202 SQL concatenation, dupl suppression for intentionally similar maturity model builders

highlights.description: Ent-backed domain store (MySQL dialect targeting Dolt) with an in-memory MemStore fake, so all domain logic is unit-testable without a running database
Full delivery model: initiatives, phases with derived status, roadmap items (RMIs), lease-based work assignments, and delivery evidence
One shared service layer powers both the `prismctl` Cobra CLI and an MCP server exposing 9 tools for Claude Code session integration
Bidirectional ROADMAP.md sync, git commit ingestion for `Refs:` trailers, and JSONL snapshot export for portable backups

added.description: Ent schema and generated code for Initiative, Phase, RoadmapItem, Assignment, DeliveryEvidence, Repository, and their dependency edges

Store interface with sub-interfaces for initiatives, phases, RMIs, assignments, evidence, and repositories, plus a MemStore in-memory fake, an Ent-backed DoltStore implementation (embedded and server modes), and typed error kinds in `pcerr`

Core domain packages: initiative lifecycle with phase status always derived from member RMIs, lease-based work assignments (claim/release/renew/complete), commit trailer parsing for `Refs:` and `Co-authored-by`, and RMI status/dependency tracking

ROADMAP.md parser, generator, and diff for bidirectional sync between markdown specs and the database; git commit ingestion for `Refs:` trailers and structured-changelog import; JSONL snapshot export with manifest for portable backups

Initiative report generation (markdown and JSON), dependency-ordered release planning, git repository scanning via gogit for commit attribution, and store-wide consistency validation (ID format, dangling dependencies, cycles, expired leases, status coherence, evidence coverage)

Shared service layer called identically by the CLI and MCP adapters (initiative CRUD, phase management, RMI operations, work claims with lease enforcement, roadmap sync, ingestion, reports, validation, export) and an MCP server exposing 9 tools over stdio transport
Root `prismcontrol` package as the importable SDK facade

Full `prismctl` Cobra CLI: database management (init, serve, create-views), a two-level dashboard (live server and static snapshot), registry, initiatives (CRUD, dependencies, program grouping), phases, RMIs (CRUD, dependencies, bulk status), work assignments (claim, release, renew, complete), roadmap sync, ingestion, reports, validation, export, and an MCP server launcher

fixed.description: Resolved all golangci-lint errors: gofmt formatting, `ReadHeaderTimeout` on the dashboard HTTP server (Slowloris mitigation), tightened `WriteFile` permissions to 0o600, gosec suppressions for a test helper exec and an intentional `safeHTML` template func, and removal of always-constant test helper parameters

changed.description: Gated all doltstore-importing code behind a `dolt` build tag so `go build`, `go test`, and `golangci-lint run` work without CGO or ICU headers; full Dolt functionality now requires `-tags dolt`

documentation.description: Added PRD, TRD, PLAN, ROADMAP, and WALKTHROUGH specs under `docs/specs/`
Added README, CLAUDE.md, and a 22-page MkDocs site (Material theme) covering getting started, user guide, CLI reference, MCP server, integrations, architecture, and case study
Documented the ICU build requirement and CI package exclusions in CLAUDE.md

dependencies.description: Bumped `dolthub/fslock` v0.0.4 to v0.0.5 and `vbauerster/mpb/v8` v8.12.1 to v8.13.0

infrastructure.description: Excluded the doltstore and cmd/prismctl packages (which require ICU C headers unavailable on standard runners) from test, lint, and CodeQL workflows; dropped Windows from the test matrix, bumped actions to v7, and fixed checkout-before-setup-go ordering

internal.description: Added .gitignore and module definition (Go 1.26, Ent, Dolt driver, MCP SDK, Cobra)
Set up standard CI workflow files, Dependabot configuration, and golangci-lint config
